name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 12 - Am 4
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 12. Recalls the need for a zero tolerance approach towards physical and verbal violence at work; stresses in particular the exposure of healthcare professionals, teachers, emergency service workers, law-enforcement officers and other workers in direct contact with the public to violence and aggression by third parties; calls on Member States to ensure effective prevention, reporting and protection mechanisms adapted to national and sectoral circumstances;
